title: spec.expected.json — mechanical acceptance contract
description: Load-bearing LLM-agnostic decoupler for the devlyn-cli harness. Defines the machine-readable acceptance criteria a spec ships alongside spec.md. Stable across model upgrades — when Opus 5 / GPT-6 / Qwen / Gemini land, this schema does not move; only the per-model adapter files in _shared/adapters/ do.

verification_commands.description: Each command must pass on the task's committed source. At least one entry is required when the spec has any observable runtime check (CLI, test command, HTTP request).

cmd.description: Shell command, executed via `subprocess.run(..., shell=True)` from the build's working directory.

argv.description: Exact argv executed without a shell; argv[0] must be non-empty. Preferred for generated and Windows contracts.

exit_code.description: Required exit code. Default 0 if omitted.

timeout_sec.description: Per-command timeout in seconds. Default 60 if omitted; maximum 600.

stdout_contains.description: Each substring must appear verbatim in (stdout + stderr) for pass.

stdout_not_contains.description: None of these substrings may appear in (stdout + stderr) for pass.

contract_refs.description: Requirements this command verifies. Ideate loop tasks name requirement IDs (R1, R2, ...) from the task Requirements and require at least one.

forbidden_patterns.description: Regex patterns scanned across the task's diff.

pattern.description: Python re.search-compatible regex. Anchored implicitly by the surrounding regex, NOT by ^ / $ unless intended.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the pattern catches and why it's forbidden.

files.description: Optional allow-list of files (substrings of diff --git lines). When present, scan is sliced to hunks touching only these files.

severity.description: disqualifier blocks acceptance; warning is recorded.

required_files.description: Files specified by literal paths that must exist in the committed source; globs are not expanded.

forbidden_files.description: Exact Git-relative paths (forward slashes, no leading ./) that must NOT appear in the diff, including both rename names; globs and directory prefixes are not expanded.

max_deps_added.description: Hard cap on package names the root package.json's dependencies and devDependencies gain over the task inputs; a move between them adds none.

pure_design.description: Declares that every Requirement is pure-design (no observable runtime check). Lets verification_commands stay empty without failing shape validation. Contradictory (and rejected) when true alongside a non-empty verification_commands.
